business_summary: TENDA Co.,LTD. engages in the DX solutions business in Japan. It operates through DX Solution Business, Techwise Consulting Business, Game Content Business, and Others segments. The company offers Dojo, a manual automatic creation software; Dojo Web Manual, a multi-device manual creation and management tool; Dojo Navi, a system operation navigation; TEnWA, a business chat service; GAKTE, an e-learning system; MS TECH Microsoft product-related services, including Office 365 implementation support and technical services, SharePoint construction support, and Notes data migration services, etc.; D-Analyzer, an RPA business automatic analysis and implementation solution platform; Tenda's DX business reform development solutions; and Crawl Krei, a semi-custom web crawler that automatically collects the necessary data in the desired format from the infinite amount of information available on the Internet, as well as in-house study sessions. It also engages in the development and maintenance of software products; consulting services; business application development, smartphone application development, BPO services, programmer training, and on-site SE service; production of VFX/game effects, CG and metaverse effects, consumer/smart game effects, and VR effects; social game platform operation and consulting; intellectual property production and consulting; Web3 technology consulting; operation and maintenance of computer systems; and development, sale, and provision of AI solutions. In addition, the company plans, develops, and operates games. Further, it engages in the restaurant and studio businesses. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan. TENDA Co.,LTD. is a subsidiary of KFC K.K.
